method: Read-only SSH: nproc, uptime, two one-second batch top snapshots, one docker stats snapshot, narrow docker inspect CPU fields, virsh list/vcpupin/emulatorpin and a bounded docker top sample. No processes, CPU pins, files or configuration changed.
interpretation: Plex's pinned CPUs are separate from Oxygen's vCPU pins. The unrestricted preview generator can compete on Oxygen's assigned CPUs; the process placement sample included those CPUs. Docker percentages are a single instantaneous container sample, not a sustained allocation. Host load and I/O wait also show shared contention.
historicalScope: The owner reported contention while discussing preceding slow measurements. This later host sample confirms contention at its own timestamp; it does not establish the exact overlap or isolate the cause of preceding timing changes. Those results do not qualify unloaded target performance.
